overall_notes: The paper focuses on using LLMs (specifically Codex) to generate training data for symbolic language tasks, then training smaller models (T5 variants) on this generated data. The evaluation uses standard automatic metrics for each task type. Human evaluation was conducted on a sample of generated data to assess quality. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization and consolidation.
